plan.fit_summary: Tier A fit: DACHSER is headquartered in Kempten, Germany [2], runs a dedicated Food Logistics business line that grew 10.1 percent to over EUR 1.8 billion in 2025 [6], and documents a compliance reporting system [3] — a direct match for temperature sensors and automatic audit reports.

who.why: Owns the business line that grew 10.1 percent to over EUR 1.8 billion in 2025 [6]; temperature control is core to this trade.

who.role: Head of Quality Management / Corporate Compliance
who.why: DACHSER documents a compliance reporting system and value-based supply chain [3]; automatic audit reports cut their documentation effort.

plan.hook: In 2025 DACHSER added space for roughly another 240,000 pallets at its 174 warehouse locations worldwide [5]. Every new temperature-controlled pallet zone needs monitoring and audit-ready records from day one — that is the opening.
plan.channel: Phone call to the Food Logistics organisation: DACHSER is headquartered in Kempten, Germany [2], so German law (UWG § 7 (2) no. 2) requires prior express consent for electronic mail, also in B2B, and courts treat social-network messages as electronic mail — no cold email or LinkedIn/XING DM as first touch. A B2B call needs at least presumed consent; the concrete business reason is the 2025 expansion of storage capacity by roughly 240,000 pallets [5], where the call offers temperature monitoring with automatic audit reports for the new food-logistics zones. Not legal advice.
avoid: Do not claim DACHSER has temperature-monitoring gaps or audit problems — no source shows a deficiency; only a compliance reporting system is documented [3].
Do not use older figures such as 15,000 employees or 294 branch offices from [8] — they conflict with current reporting of some 37,500 employees at 427 locations [5].
Do not open with air & sea freight or the Synergie Canada stake [4] — the sourced, relevant signal is food logistics warehousing, not air freight.
questions: How are temperature records across your food logistics warehouses currently captured and turned into audit-ready documentation?

draft.body: Guten Tag, laut einer Pressemitteilung von April hat DACHSER im Jahr 2025 an seinen 174 Lagerstandorten weltweit Platz für rund 240.000 zusätzliche Paletten geschaffen. Neue temperaturgeführte Zonen in der Lebensmittellogistik erfordern von Anfang an lückenlose Temperaturüberwachung und prüffähige Dokumentation. Genau dafür bieten wir mit ColdTrace drahtlose Temperatursensoren und automatische Auditberichte an. Wäre das für Ihre Food-Logistics-Zonen ein Thema?
